sections.title: Van and the possessive
sections.content: To say what clothes you have, use *van* with the possessive ending: *Van egy ruhám.* (I have a dress.) Ask with the *-d* ending: *Van sapkád?* When a number comes first, it takes the stress and *van* goes last: *Két pulóverem van.* To say you do not have it, use *nincs*: *Nincs szoknyám.* Ask how many with *Hány … van?*

items.english: How many socks do you have?

sections.content: After a vowel the endings are only *-m* and *-d*, and *a* lengthens: *ruha → ruhám*. After a consonant a linking vowel comes first: *pulóver → pulóverem*.
